name: HiveMind-cli
description: Terminal client for HiveMind — type utterances and inspect the bus from the command line, no audio hardware
author: JarbasHiveMind

setup_notes.heading: Install
setup_notes.content:
```bash
pip install HiveMind-cli
```

From source:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/JarbasHiveMind/HiveMind-cli
cd HiveMind-cli
pip install -e .
```

HiveMind CLI tracks the HiveMind bus-client 2.x stack (`ovos-bus-client>=2.0`).
`pyproject.toml` is the single source of truth for dependencies. There is no
`requirements.txt`.
